summary: Phase 1 full-stack testing of TWT. Backend: 23 pytest tests across health/openapi, auth (dev-login, cookie+Bearer /me, logout, google redirect, invalid email) and trips (create, validation 422s, list ordering desc, cross-user isolation, member/non-member detail 404, owner-only delete + cascade, no PATCH route) — 23/23 passed. Frontend: Playwright e2e on the public preview URL covering landing render, Emergent Google redirect (verified request to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>/dashboard), unauth /dashboard -> '/' redirect, dev-login cookie seeding (twt_session httpOnly SameSite=None), dashboard empty state + trips grid, create-trip modal (valid create with currency select, end<start error, empty-title error, cancel), trip card -> /trip/{id} with title + 'The stops arrive next phase.' placeholder, trip-error state for unknown trip id, delete dialog + confirm (removed from grid and backend), header avatar menu + logout (redirect to '/' and /api/auth/me returns 401). No blocking issues found.

issues: Start/End use native browser <input type='date'> (with [color-scheme:dark]) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker — inconsistent with the glassmorphism design language
No min/max constraint on the End date input; only post-submit validation prevents end<start
Delete button is opacity-0 until card hover and has no keyboard-visible focus state — not discoverable/accessible via keyboard-only navigation

action_items: Optional: replace native date inputs in CreateTripModal with the shadcn Calendar component for design consistency
Optional: move the `if (user) navigate('/dashboard')` side-effect in Landing.jsx out of the render body (use <Navigate replace /> or useEffect) to avoid a React render-phase side effect warning
Optional: make the trip delete button focus-visible (opacity-100 on focus) for keyboard accessibility
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx calls navigate() during render (render-phase side effect). Prefer `return <Navigate to='/dashboard' replace />`.

server.py sets allow_origin_regex='.*' together with allow_credentials=True when CORS_ORIGINS='*'. This reflects any origin with credentials — acceptable in dev, but must be pinned to the real frontend origin before production.
trips.list_trips loads memberships then trips with .to_list(500) and sorts in Python; the trips(start_date DESC) index is unused. Fine for Phase 1, but paginate/aggregate when trip volume grows.
Trip model exposes updated_at but no update endpoint exists; ensure any future PATCH explicitly excludes home_currency to keep it immutable.
auth.dev_login is correctly gated on ENV, but ENV is read once at import time — acceptable; just confirm ENV is not 'dev' in prod deployment config.
seed_data_creation: Users created via dev-login: alice@twt.app, bob@twt.app, carol@twt.app, dave@twt.app, zoe@twt.app. All TEST_* trips created during testing were deleted (verified 0 remaining for zoe, TEST_UI trips deleted for alice). Pre-existing 'Iberian Loop' trip for alice@twt.app was left untouched.
test_credentials: No passwords. Use POST /api/auth/dev-login {email, name} (ENV=dev). Cookie: twt_session (httpOnly, secure, SameSite=None); JSON body also returns session_token for Bearer auth.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (23 tests, all green; run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v`). It self-cleans TEST_* trips. Frontend cookie seeding pattern that works: page.goto(BASE) then page.evaluate fetch('/api/auth/dev-login', {credentials:'include'}) then goto /dashboard. Card delete button testid is `trip-delete-btn-{trip_id}` (not `delete-trip-btn`) and requires hovering `[data-testid^="trip-card-"]` first. Trip card testids: trip-card-{id}, trip-title-{id}, trip-role-badge-{id}.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found. One earlier apparent failure ('no redirect to Emergent auth detected') was a test artifact: aborting the auth.emergentagent.com route produced a chrome-error page; re-testing with a request listener confirmed the correct navigation URL https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>%2Fdashboard.
